criteria.description: Right-edge sheet reaches every documented state: toggle open/close at all widths, Escape with focus return to the toggle, outside/backdrop close, destination close for primary/contact/social/CTA classes, same-breakpoint resize stability, 767/768/769 seam stability, JS-disabled PE tree

Exactly one brand, five primary title-only destinations, one permanent top-bar action, one named toggle, one sheet close, contact title/phone/email/address, five social destinations, zero chevrons — no invented panel CTA or rich chrome

Full-width bar logo-left / action+toggle-right at all widths; destinations only in the right sheet (or PE stack); no permanent horizontal desktop link row; 320/340 keep 44px targets without html/root overflow
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
